name: content-pipeline
description: End-to-end content pipeline: discover new content via RSS → structure, classify, embed → index into MCP knowledge base

preExec.description: Run unified discover → structure pipeline. Skips structuring if no new content found.

instructions: Review the JSON output from the pipeline.
If new articles were discovered AND processed, summarize what was found and indexed.
If structuring was skipped (no new content), just confirm the pipeline ran cleanly.
If any step failed, flag the error for investigation.
